title: Zesty Roasted Sardinian Beef Kidney Stracciatella
description: A hearty Italian dish featuring roasted beef kidney in a rich stracciatella sauce, served in an agave leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the beef kidney pieces with olive oil, garlic, and thyme until they are evenly coated.
Spread the beef kidney pieces in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While the beef is roasting, combine chicken broth, lemon juice, and tomato paste in a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the sauce for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
After the beef has roasted for 20 minutes, remove it from the oven and deglaze the baking sheet with the sauce, scraping up any browned bits.
Return the beef kidney pieces to the sauce and stir to coat.
Spoon the beef and sauce mixture into the agave leaves, dividing it evenly among the four leaves.
Serve the stracciatella hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
